integration: Integrated into GroundEnemy through shared core/actor/vehicleArt.js and VehicleSprite.js, including its existing catalogue story. The same atlas and clip definitions are used by Kluz. The preparation script refreshes the runtime mapping. Scale uniformly to contain sourceContentBounds in the unchanged 137 x 60 collision rectangle; center the content bounds on the existing actor center. Source-cell padding must not change collision dimensions or ground placement. Drive when dx differs from scrollSpeed, including while firing; scrolling alone also moves idle and dead actors. Advance by game dt only; pause freezes phase, reset clears it. Dead holds idle frame 0 with existing destruction effects until ART-08 supplies a wreck.
